cover.title: Workers manual
cover.subtitle: Team QR and unit QR — tasks on site

actions.label: Unit QR
actions.text: Attached to a machine, room or asset. Citizens can report issues here. As a worker, sign in via worker mode to start or complete open tasks on that unit.

actions.label: Team QR
actions.text: Placed with the team (warehouse, workshop, …). Sign in here to see and handle all open tasks for your team, regardless of which unit they belong to.

actions.label: Name and icon
actions.text: Scan the QR, enter your name and choose your personal icon. This helps the team see who picked up which task.

actions.label: First time
actions.text: New to the team? Register via «New worker» on the team portal, then choose your icon.

actions.label: Sign out
actions.text: Sign out when finished so a colleague can use the same icon on another device.

actions.label: Open tasks
actions.text: After signing in you see all open tasks for your team. Tap a task to view details.

actions.label: Start
actions.text: Set a task to «In progress» when you start. Other team members will see you are working on it.

actions.label: Complete
actions.text: Finish with a short note and optional photos. The task status becomes «Done».

actions.label: Worker mode
actions.text: On the unit page, switch to worker mode, sign in and see only tasks for that unit.

actions.label: Dynamic QR
actions.text: Via the team portal you can link a loose QR to a unit and register GPS coordinates — useful for mobile assets.

actions.label: Issues
actions.text: Citizens can submit an issue on the same unit QR; you handle the related task.

actions.label: Add photos
actions.text: When starting or completing a task, add photos as proof or explanation. Photos are automatically compressed for fast upload.

actions.label: Wait for upload
actions.text: Wait until the upload finishes before confirming — otherwise photos will be missing from the task.

chapters.title: Task statuses
chapters.status_note: Each task goes through the statuses below.

statuses.new: Not started yet — waiting for a worker.
statuses.in_progress: Someone is working on it on site.
statuses.closed: Closed by admin — issue can be closed.
